claims.text: Supportive: cool moist compresses, colloidal oatmeal baths, calamine lotion, aluminum acetate (Burow solution) soaks for mild derm; limited evidence
claims.quote: Supportive therapy includes cool, moist compresses, colloidal oatmeal baths, calamine lotion, and aluminum acetate (Burow solution) soaks, which are frequently recommended for symptomatic relief in patients with mild dermatitis, although the evidence supporting these measures is limited.

claims.text: Topical tx: cool compresses (saline or Burow solution) and corticosteroids
claims.quote: Topical treatment includes cool compresses (saline or Burow solution) and corticosteroids.
